description: run.py:1151 resolves df_tuning_config but the non-interactive path pops it (run.py:2446) instead of adding it to benchmark_config.options (interactive does, run.py:2444), so 'benchbox run --tuning <file>' on a DataFrame platform builds an untuned adapter and its bundle has no applied ledger. Fix the cli/** plumbing. From tuning-df-ledger-parity-20260716.
